verdict.rationale: New Relic documents official APM agents/SDKs for seven major languages (Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, Ruby), a GraphQL API (NerdGraph) with an interactive explorer, OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation, and an official open-source CLI on GitHub, giving AI-native developers multiple first-party ways to build against the platform. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec (probe confirms 404s), and independent hands-on validation specifically of SDK/agent developer experience beyond general product complaints.
